facts.text: The San Regis is a former hotel particulier, a private mansion, built in the 19th century.
facts.excerpt: The San Régis is a former hôtel particulier (private mansion) built in the 19th century

facts.text: The former mansion is today fully restored and furnished with countless works of art.
facts.excerpt: today fully restored, exquisitely decorated and lavishly furnished with countless works of art

facts.text: The hotel sits on a secluded street in the Golden Triangle of Paris's 8th arrondissement.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away in a charming and secluded street at the heart of the 'Golden Triangle' in Paris's 8th arrondissement

facts.text: The hotel is well placed for the Champs-Elysees district, Avenue Montaigne and the Grand Palais.
facts.excerpt: the San Régis is ideally located for enjoying the lively Champs-Elysées district, Avenue Montaigne and the Grand Palais

facts.text: Each bedroom and suite has its own distinctive style.
facts.excerpt: Each of the 30 bedrooms and 12 suites has its own distinctive style

facts.text: Rooms are furnished with fabrics from leading design houses alongside antique and period furniture.
facts.excerpt: furnished with sumptuous fabrics from the finest Houses, complementing the antique and period furniture

facts.text: The hotel is owned by the Georges family, who wish to preserve the atmosphere of a family home.
facts.excerpt: The owners of the hotel, the Georges family, wish to preserve the special atmosphere of a family home.

facts.text: The furnishings and paintings have all been individually hunted down.
facts.excerpt: The sought after furnishings and paintings have all been painstakingly hunted down

facts.text: The hotel sits behind a discreet, understated entrance.
facts.excerpt: hidden behind a discreet and understated entrance lies one of the most exclusive addresses in Paris

facts.text: The hotel's restaurant is called Les Confidences.
The hotel offers discreet and personalised service.
facts.excerpt: Discreet and personalised service, combined with the stylish and elegant decor

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a preferred residence for VIPs, celebrities and artists seeking authenticity and discretion.
facts.excerpt: one of the preferred places of residence for VIPs, celebrities and artists in search of authenticity and discretion

facts.text: The hotel has been acclaimed by Travel+Leisure, Forbes Travel Guide and Andrew Harper's Hideaway Report.
facts.excerpt: Acclaimed for many years by leading travel specialists including Travel+Leisure, Forbes Travel Guide, and Andrew Harper’s Hideaway Report

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2024 and 2025.
The hotel's address is 12 Rue Jean Goujon in Paris.
The hotel has 30 bedrooms and 12 suites.
facts.excerpt: Each of the 30 bedrooms and 12 suites

contradictions.note: Official site says 30 bedrooms and 12 suites (42); Conde Nast Traveler lists 44 rooms
